data.one_liner: Insert a given element between each element of an Iterable or List.
data.what_it_does: The package provides a function that takes an iterable and a separator element and returns a new iterable where the separator is placed between every original element. It works with any Dart collection and supports null‑safety.
use_when: You need to add separators (e.g., commas, dividers) when formatting output
You want a concise way to interleave items in a list without writing manual loops
avoid_when: Performance‑critical code with very large collections
When you need asynchronous or stream‑based interleaving
strengths: Zero dependencies","Null‑safety support","Works with any Iterable","Very small API surface
weaknesses: Only works with synchronous iterables","No built‑in support for streams or async generators
